client_claims.text: You can move your current account, direct debits, and standing orders to Monzo using the UK's Current Account Switch Service (CASS).
The switch takes 7 working days, is completely free, and is backed by a guarantee.
client_claims.note: No fact covers switch timing or guarantee.

client_claims.text: Open the Monzo app and select Switch to Monzo, entering old sort code, account number and last 5 digits of the debit card.
client_claims.note: App steps are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Stray payments sent to your old details are automatically redirected to Monzo for at least 3 years.
